title: 咬合樁止水壁施工~Secant-pile cutoff-wall construction
focus: 咬合幾何、先後樁齡期與止水連續性~Secant geometry, primary-pile age and cutoff continuity
summary: 咬合樁牆以相鄰樁體互相切入形成連續擋土與止水系統，其性能受樁位、垂直度、切削時齡及結構樁剛度共同控制。本課將幾何咬合與材料強度分開驗證，再檢查冠梁傳力、嵌入深度、缺口滲流與長期裂縫，建立全深度的竣工證據。~Secant walls use overlapping piles to form a retaining and cutoff system governed by position, verticality, cutting age and structural-pile stiffness. The course verifies geometric overlap separately from material strength, then examines capping-beam transfer, embedment, defect seepage and long-term cracking through full-depth as-built evidence.

units.title: 設計咬合量的機理與驗證~Nominal overlap mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 相鄰圓樁相交形成牆體連續性，中心距與直徑共同決定名目咬合量。樁位偏差及鑽孔彎曲會沿深度改變實際交疊，槽口看起來連續不代表深部也完整；止水與結構連續性須分別考慮主次樁材料及鋼筋配置。此式只給兩個等直徑平行圓柱的線性咬合尺寸，未證明接觸品質或抗剪連續性；不等徑與偏斜需按三維幾何處理。~Intersecting circular piles create wall continuity, with centre spacing and diameter defining nominal overlap. Position errors and curved bores change overlap with depth, so a continuous collar does not prove deep continuity. Hydraulic and structural performance must separately account for primary-secondary materials and reinforcement arrangements. This expression gives a linear overlap for equal parallel cylinders only and proves neither contact quality nor shear continuity; unequal diameters and deviations require three-dimensional geometry.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設相同樁徑D=1.0 m、中心距s=0.8 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.20 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For equal pile diameter D=1.0 m and spacing s=0.8 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.20 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 量測導牆樁位與全深孔斜，重建相鄰圓柱交集，將最小咬合位置與含水層對照。咬合驗收須採全深相對幾何，不只查單樁容許誤差；異常段由地工設計者核定補充驗證。~Survey guide-wall positions and full-depth inclinations, reconstruct adjacent cylinder intersections, and compare minimum overlap locations with aquifers. Accept overlap from full-depth relative geometry rather than single-pile tolerances alone; the geotechnical designer approves supplementary investigation of anomalies.
units.failure: 深部樁體分離會形成滲流缺口，土砂流失可能先於可見牆面裂縫出現。此式只給兩個等直徑平行圓柱的線性咬合尺寸，未證明接觸品質或抗剪連續性；不等徑與偏斜需按三維幾何處理。~Deep separation creates seepage gaps, and soil loss may precede visible wall cracking. This expression gives a linear overlap for equal parallel cylinders only and proves neither contact quality nor shear continuity; unequal diameters and deviations require three-dimensional geometry.
units.misconception: 樁頂有咬合就能保證所有深度的止水連續性。~Overlap at the pile heads guarantees cutoff continuity at every depth.
units.practice: 咬合驗收須採全深相對幾何，不只查單樁容許誤差；異常段由地工設計者核定補充驗證。此式只給兩個等直徑平行圓柱的線性咬合尺寸，未證明接觸品質或抗剪連續性；不等徑與偏斜需按三維幾何處理。~Accept overlap from full-depth relative geometry rather than single-pile tolerances alone; the geotechnical designer approves supplementary investigation of anomalies. This expression gives a linear overlap for equal parallel cylinders only and proves neither contact quality nor shear continuity; unequal diameters and deviations require three-dimensional geometry.

units.anchor: 先行樁切削齡期~Primary-pile cutting age
units.title: 先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證~Primary-pile cutting age mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 次樁鑽掘必須切入先行樁，先行材料太軟可能被擠移，太硬則會使刀具偏轉或難以切削。可切削窗口受配比、溫度與養護影響，不能只用日曆天數管理；施工排程需與材料強度發展及實際切入紀錄連結。時間差不是材料強度，亦沒有通用合格齡期；應以代表性試驗建立強度與可切削性的場址關係。~Secondary drilling must cut into primary piles. Material that is too soft may displace, while excessive hardness can deflect tools or impede cutting. The workable window depends on mix, temperature and curing, so calendar age alone is inadequate; sequencing must be linked to strength development and actual cutting behaviour. Elapsed time is not material strength and has no universal acceptance age; representative tests must establish the site-specific relation between strength and cuttability.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設先行樁澆置完成t₁=24 h、次樁切入t₂=96 h，相對齡期Δt=t₂−t₁=72 h。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For primary completion t₁=24 h and secondary cutting t₂=96 h on one clock, elapsed age Δt=72 h. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以同養護試體與溫度紀錄核對切削時強度，再比較鑽進扭矩、偏斜與回收材料。排程需保留澆置、切入及材料強度證據；延誤時由材料及成樁負責人重新核定切削窗口。~Use companion-cured samples and temperature records to estimate cutting-age strength, then compare drilling torque, deviation and recovered material. Retain placement, cutting and strength evidence in the schedule; materials and piling leads reassess the cutting window after delays.
units.failure: 齡期超窗可能使次樁偏離先行樁，留下深部未咬合帶，即使鑽達設計深度仍無法止水。時間差不是材料強度，亦沒有通用合格齡期；應以代表性試驗建立強度與可切削性的場址關係。~Cutting outside the workable window can deflect the secondary pile and leave a deep unconnected strip despite reaching design depth. Elapsed time is not material strength and has no universal acceptance age; representative tests must establish the site-specific relation between strength and cuttability.
units.misconception: 固定等三天就能適用所有氣溫與先行樁配比。~Waiting a fixed three days works for every temperature and primary-pile mix.
units.practice: 排程需保留澆置、切入及材料強度證據；延誤時由材料及成樁負責人重新核定切削窗口。時間差不是材料強度，亦沒有通用合格齡期；應以代表性試驗建立強度與可切削性的場址關係。~Retain placement, cutting and strength evidence in the schedule; materials and piling leads reassess the cutting window after delays. Elapsed time is not material strength and has no universal acceptance age; representative tests must establish the site-specific relation between strength and cuttability.

units.title: 結構樁剛度的機理與驗證~Structural-pile stiffness mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 擋土牆的彎曲剛度取決於真正承擔結構作用的樁列，不能把所有軟質先行樁都當成同樣剛度的鋼筋混凝土。圓截面慣性矩隨直徑四次方增加，但開裂、咬合切削與配筋會改變有效剛度，並影響各樁分擔的土壓。毛截面慣性矩是幾何量而非整體牆剛度，還須乘相應模數並考慮每米樁數；裂縫及接觸滑移可能主導變形。~Wall bending stiffness depends on the piles actually assigned structural action; soft primary piles cannot automatically be treated as equally stiff reinforced concrete. Circular-section inertia increases with diameter to the fourth power, but cracking, secant cuts and reinforcement change effective stiffness and the pressure shared by individual piles. Gross inertia is geometric rather than system stiffness; the corresponding modulus and piles per metre are also needed, while cracking and interface slip may govern deformation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設完整實心圓截面D=1 m，毛截面I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For a complete solid circular section D=1 m, gross second moment I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 將實際樁徑、切削輪廓及鋼筋位置輸入截面分析，以測得牆位移比較開裂與未開裂剛度範圍。計算書應標明主次樁各自材料與開裂假設；結構設計者核准等值牆剛度後才用於整體開挖模型。~Insert actual diameter, cut profile and reinforcement into section analysis, comparing measured wall movement with cracked and uncracked stiffness bounds. Identify primary-secondary materials and cracking assumptions; the structural designer approves equivalent wall stiffness before it is used in excavation analysis.
units.failure: 高估先行樁剛度會低估牆位移，並錯估冠梁與支撐反力，造成鄰近資產變形超出預期。毛截面慣性矩是幾何量而非整體牆剛度，還須乘相應模數並考慮每米樁數；裂縫及接觸滑移可能主導變形。~Overstating primary-pile stiffness underestimates wall movement and misallocates cap and strut forces, increasing unexpected adjacent-asset deformation. Gross inertia is geometric rather than system stiffness; the corresponding modulus and piles per metre are also needed, while cracking and interface slip may govern deformation.
units.misconception: 所有咬合樁都可以用相同的毛截面剛度相加。~All secant piles can be added using identical gross-section stiffness.
units.practice: 計算書應標明主次樁各自材料與開裂假設；結構設計者核准等值牆剛度後才用於整體開挖模型。毛截面慣性矩是幾何量而非整體牆剛度，還須乘相應模數並考慮每米樁數；裂縫及接觸滑移可能主導變形。~Identify primary-secondary materials and cracking assumptions; the structural designer approves equivalent wall stiffness before it is used in excavation analysis. Gross inertia is geometric rather than system stiffness; the corresponding modulus and piles per metre are also needed, while cracking and interface slip may govern deformation.

units.title: 冠梁荷載轉移的機理與驗證~Capping-beam transfer mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 冠梁把不均勻樁頭反力重新分配到鄰近樁體，並為上部支撐提供連續的傳力界面。它的作用取決於樁頭嵌入、鋼筋錨定與接縫，不能只把冠梁視為整平構件；局部空樁或樁頭缺陷會增加其跨越需求。簡支點載模型只示範局部彎矩，真實冠梁常為連續梁且受扭；樁頭剛度及支撐偏心須另行納入。~A capping beam redistributes unequal pile-head reactions and provides a continuous interface for upper support. Its function depends on pile embedment, reinforcement anchorage and joints, not merely surface levelling. A missing or defective pile head increases the distance over which the beam must bridge and transfer load. The simple point-load model illustrates local bending only; actual caps are often continuous and torsion-sensitive, requiring pile-head stiffness and support eccentricity.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設簡支冠梁跨L=3 m、跨中集中力P=400 kN，Mmax=PL/4=300 kN·m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For a simply supported cap span L=3 m and central force P=400 kN, Mmax=PL/4=300 kN·m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 核對樁頭標高、混凝土品質與主筋錨定長度，將支撐反力位置和樁中心放在同一配筋圖。澆置前確認樁頭與冠梁傳力細部；支撐位置變更須由冠梁設計者重新核對，而非現場直接移座。~Verify pile-head level, concrete quality and bar anchorage, placing support reactions and pile centres on one reinforcement drawing. Confirm pile-head transfer details before casting; the cap designer reviews support relocation instead of allowing seats to be moved directly on site.
units.failure: 樁頭處理不足使冠梁局部失去支承，裂縫可能集中在支撐座下方並造成反力轉移。簡支點載模型只示範局部彎矩，真實冠梁常為連續梁且受扭；樁頭剛度及支撐偏心須另行納入。~Poor pile-head preparation can remove local cap support, concentrating cracks below strut seats and redistributing reactions. The simple point-load model illustrates local bending only; actual caps are often continuous and torsion-sensitive, requiring pile-head stiffness and support eccentricity.
units.misconception: 冠梁只是把樁頭連起來，不需要分析彎矩與剪力。~A cap merely connects pile heads and needs no bending or shear analysis.
units.practice: 澆置前確認樁頭與冠梁傳力細部；支撐位置變更須由冠梁設計者重新核對，而非現場直接移座。簡支點載模型只示範局部彎矩，真實冠梁常為連續梁且受扭；樁頭剛度及支撐偏心須另行納入。~Confirm pile-head transfer details before casting; the cap designer reviews support relocation instead of allowing seats to be moved directly on site. The simple point-load model illustrates local bending only; actual caps are often continuous and torsion-sensitive, requiring pile-head stiffness and support eccentricity.

units.anchor: 閉合定位誤差~Closure positioning error
units.title: 閉合定位誤差的機理與驗證~Closure positioning error mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 封閉圍護牆的最後接合位置累積了前面樁位誤差，不能假設每根樁單獨合格就能自然閉合。誤差可能有共同方向的系統偏差，也可能是獨立隨機偏差；兩者需要不同組合方法，並應及早用獨立測量發現。平方和開根號只適用於指定的獨立隨機假設，最不利容差疊加須另算；標準差也不是最大可能誤差。~The final connection in a closed wall inherits earlier positioning errors; individually acceptable piles do not guarantee closure. Errors may share a systematic direction or be independent random deviations, requiring different combination rules. Independent survey should identify the distinction before the final opening becomes too constrained to correct. Root-sum-square applies only under the stated independence assumptions; worst-case tolerance accumulation requires separate analysis, and a standard deviation is not a maximum error.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設4項獨立零均值誤差各標準差σ=15 mm，合成σtot=√(4σ²)=30 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For four independent zero-mean errors each with standard deviation σ=15 mm, combined σtot=√(4σ²)=30 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 用獨立控制網重測起終點，將誤差方向分解，檢查共同偏移後再作統計合成。設置中途閉合檢核與備用修正區，測量負責人應在樁序逼近最後接頭前提交偏差分析。~Resurvey start and closure points from independent control, resolving error directions and checking common bias before statistical combination. Provide interim closure checks and a correction allowance; the survey lead reports deviations before the pile sequence approaches the final connection.
units.failure: 把系統偏差誤當隨機誤差會低估閉合缺口，最後一樁可能難以兼顧咬合與鋼筋籠淨距。平方和開根號只適用於指定的獨立隨機假設，最不利容差疊加須另算；標準差也不是最大可能誤差。~Treating systematic bias as random underestimates closure gaps and can leave the final pile unable to achieve both overlap and cage clearance. Root-sum-square applies only under the stated independence assumptions; worst-case tolerance accumulation requires separate analysis, and a standard deviation is not a maximum error.
units.misconception: 四項定位誤差一律都可以用平方和開根號合成。~Four positioning errors can always be combined by root-sum-square.
units.practice: 設置中途閉合檢核與備用修正區，測量負責人應在樁序逼近最後接頭前提交偏差分析。平方和開根號只適用於指定的獨立隨機假設，最不利容差疊加須另算；標準差也不是最大可能誤差。~Provide interim closure checks and a correction allowance; the survey lead reports deviations before the pile sequence approaches the final connection. Root-sum-square applies only under the stated independence assumptions; worst-case tolerance accumulation requires separate analysis, and a standard deviation is not a maximum error.

units.title: 樁趾嵌入的機理與驗證~Toe embedment mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 開挖面以下的樁段藉由土體反力提供轉動拘束與側向平衡，嵌入深度同時影響止水路徑。土體被動反力需要位移才能動員，不能只用幾何深度宣稱固定端；深部軟弱層或滲流可能削弱原本假設的支承。反力乘力臂是力矩平衡，不證明土體能動員該反力；承載、變形、基底隆起及滲流穩定均須獨立檢查。~The embedded pile below excavation provides rotational restraint and lateral equilibrium through soil reaction while also lengthening seepage paths. Passive resistance needs movement to mobilize, so embedment depth alone does not establish a fixed end. Deep weak layers or seepage can reduce the assumed support and alter wall deformation. Reaction times lever arm is equilibrium, not proof that soil can mobilize the reaction; resistance, deformation, base heave and seepage stability require independent checks.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設每米牆長的反力R=500 kN/m、對開挖底的力臂z=2 m，抗力矩M=Rz=1000 kN·m/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For reaction R=500 kN per metre of wall and lever arm z=2 m about excavation level, resisting moment M=Rz=1000 kN·m/m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以地層剖面、樁長與深部傾度曲線核對反力區，檢查支點是否隨開挖或水位改變。樁底地層與深度須留可追溯紀錄；地層異常由地工設計者重新核定嵌入及支撐配置。~Check reaction zones against stratigraphy, pile length and deep inclinometer profiles, examining whether restraint changes with excavation or groundwater. Retain traceable toe-depth and ground records; the geotechnical designer revises embedment and support layout when unexpected strata are encountered.
units.failure: 未到達設計嵌入層會使牆趾旋轉，表面支撐力可能上升並伴隨開挖底隆起。反力乘力臂是力矩平衡，不證明土體能動員該反力；承載、變形、基底隆起及滲流穩定均須獨立檢查。~Failure to reach the intended bearing stratum allows toe rotation, potentially increasing strut force and causing base movement. Reaction times lever arm is equilibrium, not proof that soil can mobilize the reaction; resistance, deformation, base heave and seepage stability require independent checks.
units.misconception: 只要樁長達到圖面數字，樁趾就一定是完全固定。~Reaching the drawing's pile length guarantees a fully fixed toe.
units.practice: 樁底地層與深度須留可追溯紀錄；地層異常由地工設計者重新核定嵌入及支撐配置。反力乘力臂是力矩平衡，不證明土體能動員該反力；承載、變形、基底隆起及滲流穩定均須獨立檢查。~Retain traceable toe-depth and ground records; the geotechnical designer revises embedment and support layout when unexpected strata are encountered. Reaction times lever arm is equilibrium, not proof that soil can mobilize the reaction; resistance, deformation, base heave and seepage stability require independent checks.

units.title: 缺口漏水的機理與驗證~Defect leakage mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 咬合牆的水密性常由局部缺口或施工接面控制，而不是整個混凝土樁的平均滲透性。流量與缺口面積及水力坡降相關，隨開挖降水增加的壓差會放大弱路徑；帶砂出水則表示地層本身可能正在流失。等效達西模型只供量級比較，開放裂縫可能屬非達西流；沒有水頭資料就不能從一次流量倒推出可靠滲透係數。~Secant-wall sealing is often controlled by local gaps or construction interfaces rather than average concrete permeability. Flow depends on defect area and hydraulic gradient, and drawdown increases the driving pressure along weak paths. Sediment-carrying inflow indicates that the ground itself may be escaping, not merely water leaking through a stable interface. The equivalent Darcy model provides scale only; open fractures may be non-Darcy, and one discharge measurement without head data cannot establish reliable permeability.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設缺口等效k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s、A=0.5 m²、i=10，Q=kAi=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For equivalent defect permeability k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s, area A=0.5 m² and gradient i=10, Q=kAi=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 分區量測出水量與混濁度，對照內外水頭及孔斜模型，辨認缺口而非直接推定整牆材料不良。異常出水需建立位置、水頭與顆粒紀錄；修補由地工及壁體設計者共同核定並觀察周邊沉陷。~Measure zoned flow and turbidity against internal-external heads and bore-deviation models to identify gaps rather than assuming uniformly poor wall material. Record leak location, head and particles; geotechnical and wall designers jointly approve repair and require observation of adjacent settlement.
units.failure: 集中漏水可帶走細砂，形成外側空洞與沉陷；只封內側漏點可能使壓力轉移到另一缺口。等效達西模型只供量級比較，開放裂縫可能屬非達西流；沒有水頭資料就不能從一次流量倒推出可靠滲透係數。~Concentrated leakage can remove fines and form external voids and settlement; sealing one internal leak may transfer pressure to another gap. The equivalent Darcy model provides scale only; open fractures may be non-Darcy, and one discharge measurement without head data cannot establish reliable permeability.
units.misconception: 小流量清水滲漏永遠不會演變成帶砂地層流失。~A small clear-water leak can never develop into sediment-carrying ground loss.
units.practice: 異常出水需建立位置、水頭與顆粒紀錄；修補由地工及壁體設計者共同核定並觀察周邊沉陷。等效達西模型只供量級比較，開放裂縫可能屬非達西流；沒有水頭資料就不能從一次流量倒推出可靠滲透係數。~Record leak location, head and particles; geotechnical and wall designers jointly approve repair and require observation of adjacent settlement. The equivalent Darcy model provides scale only; open fractures may be non-Darcy, and one discharge measurement without head data cannot establish reliable permeability.

units.title: 彎曲應力增量的機理與驗證~Bending-stress increment mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 壁體應變及彎曲需求可用截面模數建立簡化關係，但開裂鋼筋混凝土的應力分布與未開裂截面不同。從量測應力反推彎矩前，需知道所用位置及中性軸，不能把單側應變當純彎曲而忽略軸力與溫度。這是線彈性應力增量示範，不是混凝土容許應力；若截面開裂或配筋受力，應採相容的換算截面或非線性分析。~Section modulus provides a simplified relation between bending and stress, but cracked reinforced concrete differs from an uncracked section. Inferring moment from a measured stress requires the measurement location and neutral axis. One-sided strain cannot be treated as pure bending without separating axial force and temperature effects. This illustrates an elastic stress increment, not an allowable concrete stress; cracking or reinforcement action requires compatible transformed-section or nonlinear analysis.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設線彈性截面模數Z=0.04 m³、彎曲應力增量Δσ=20 MPa，ΔM=ΔσZ=0.8 MN·m=800 kN·m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For elastic section modulus Z=0.04 m³ and bending-stress increment Δσ=20 MPa, ΔM=ΔσZ=0.8 MN·m=800 kN·m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 使用兩側應變與溫度資料分離軸向及彎曲增量，核對所採截面模數與實際開裂狀態。監測解算式應由結構設計者確認材料、位置及零點；儀器更換與截面狀態改變都須重新評估換算關係。~Use opposite-face strain and temperature to separate axial and bending increments, verifying the selected section modulus against the actual cracked condition. The structural designer approves materials, positions and zero references used in monitoring conversion; sensor replacement or section changes require renewed assessment.
units.failure: 把鋼筋局部應變乘上整體毛截面參數，會得到不相容的彎矩，導致錯誤支撐需求。這是線彈性應力增量示範，不是混凝土容許應力；若截面開裂或配筋受力，應採相容的換算截面或非線性分析。~Combining local reinforcement strain with incompatible gross-section properties produces erroneous moments and misleading support demands. This illustrates an elastic stress increment, not an allowable concrete stress; cracking or reinforcement action requires compatible transformed-section or nonlinear analysis.
units.misconception: 任何一個應變計都可直接量出整根樁的彎矩。~Any single strain gauge directly measures the entire pile's bending moment.
units.practice: 監測解算式應由結構設計者確認材料、位置及零點；儀器更換與截面狀態改變都須重新評估換算關係。這是線彈性應力增量示範，不是混凝土容許應力；若截面開裂或配筋受力，應採相容的換算截面或非線性分析。~The structural designer approves materials, positions and zero references used in monitoring conversion; sensor replacement or section changes require renewed assessment. This illustrates an elastic stress increment, not an allowable concrete stress; cracking or reinforcement action requires compatible transformed-section or nonlinear analysis.

units.title: 偏斜容差餘量的機理與驗證~Deviation allowance mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 設計咬合量需留給施工偏差、直徑變異與量測不確定度，不能全部視為可使用的止水厚度。兩樁向相反方向偏斜時，最小咬合會同時被削減；誤差有相關性時，最不利組合比平均值更能指出需要驗證的深度。線性相減是保守幾何示意，沒有涵蓋三維曲線樁形與材料缺陷；正餘量亦不能自行證明接面強度與水密。~Nominal overlap must accommodate positional errors, diameter variation and measurement uncertainty rather than all being credited as usable cutoff thickness. Opposite deviations of adjacent piles reduce overlap simultaneously. Where errors are correlated, adverse combinations identify critical depths more effectively than average deviations do. Linear subtraction is an adverse geometric illustration, not a full curved-pile model; positive reserve does not independently establish interface strength or sealing.
units.model: 原創教學假設：名目咬合o=0.20 m、兩樁各向外偏移δ=0.06 m，最小線性餘量omin=o−2δ=0.08 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For nominal overlap o=0.20 m and outward deviation δ=0.06 m for each pile, minimum linear reserve omin=o−2δ=0.08 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 將全深孔斜與直徑量測的誤差範圍一起合成，檢查最小交集是否仍覆蓋需要止水的含水層。竣工資料須指出最不利深度及剩餘不確定度；若餘量小於核定要求，設計者應指定補測或補強停留點。~Combine full-depth deviation and diameter uncertainty, checking whether the minimum intersection still spans the aquifers requiring cutoff. As-built records identify adverse depths and residual uncertainty; when reserve is below approved requirements, the designer specifies additional investigation or strengthening hold points.
units.failure: 只用平均偏斜可能掩蓋局部不咬合，低滲透層上方的細小缺口也可能形成主要水路。線性相減是保守幾何示意，沒有涵蓋三維曲線樁形與材料缺陷；正餘量亦不能自行證明接面強度與水密。~Mean deviation can conceal a local separation, and a small gap above a low-permeability layer can become the dominant water path. Linear subtraction is an adverse geometric illustration, not a full curved-pile model; positive reserve does not independently establish interface strength or sealing.
units.misconception: 設計咬合量扣除平均偏差後為正，就不需其他驗證。~Positive overlap after subtracting mean deviation needs no further verification.
units.practice: 竣工資料須指出最不利深度及剩餘不確定度；若餘量小於核定要求，設計者應指定補測或補強停留點。線性相減是保守幾何示意，沒有涵蓋三維曲線樁形與材料缺陷；正餘量亦不能自行證明接面強度與水密。~As-built records identify adverse depths and residual uncertainty; when reserve is below approved requirements, the designer specifies additional investigation or strengthening hold points. Linear subtraction is an adverse geometric illustration, not a full curved-pile model; positive reserve does not independently establish interface strength or sealing.

units.anchor: 營運漏水趨勢~Operational leakage trend
units.title: 營運漏水趨勢的機理與驗證~Operational leakage trend mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 完工後的滲漏量需連同外水頭與降雨判讀，相同流量可能來自不同壓差。長期裂縫、接面位移與水化學沉積會改變路徑，流量下降也可能是排水口堵塞而非牆體改善；交接紀錄必須保存可比較的環境基準。短期平均流量不代表永久水密程度，也不是通用允收值；應依資產用途、地下水與地層流失風險建立專案標準。~Operational leakage must be interpreted with external head and rainfall because identical flow can occur under different pressure differences. Cracking, joint movement and chemical deposits change paths over time; falling flow may mean an obstructed drain rather than improved wall sealing. Handover must preserve comparable environmental baselines. Short-term mean discharge is not permanent sealing performance or a universal limit; project criteria depend on asset use, groundwater and potential ground loss.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設收集漏水V=12 L、時間t=6 h，平均Q=V/t=2 L/h。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For collected leakage V=12 L over t=6 h, mean discharge Q=V/t=2 L/h. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 用固定集水區與校正容器量測流量，記錄外水位及清理事件，將趨勢和鄰房高程一起檢視。維護移交應包括接頭圖、集水範圍及異常回報責任；營運單位遇到水頭與流量不一致時應請設計專業判讀。~Measure discharge with fixed catchments and calibrated containers, record external levels and cleaning events, and review trends beside neighbouring-building elevations. Handover includes joint maps, catchments and reporting responsibilities; operators seek engineering interpretation when head and flow trends disagree.
units.failure: 無環境基準的流量比較可能漏掉排水堵塞，水壓升高後才在其他接頭出現新的滲漏。短期平均流量不代表永久水密程度，也不是通用允收值；應依資產用途、地下水與地層流失風險建立專案標準。~Flow comparisons without environmental baselines can miss drainage blockage until higher pressure creates leakage at other joints. Short-term mean discharge is not permanent sealing performance or a universal limit; project criteria depend on asset use, groundwater and potential ground loss.
units.misconception: 漏水量逐年下降就一定表示牆體性能逐年改善。~Declining annual leakage necessarily indicates improving wall performance.
units.practice: 維護移交應包括接頭圖、集水範圍及異常回報責任；營運單位遇到水頭與流量不一致時應請設計專業判讀。短期平均流量不代表永久水密程度，也不是通用允收值；應依資產用途、地下水與地層流失風險建立專案標準。~Handover includes joint maps, catchments and reporting responsibilities; operators seek engineering interpretation when head and flow trends disagree. Short-term mean discharge is not permanent sealing performance or a universal limit; project criteria depend on asset use, groundwater and potential ground loss.

example: 原創教學例：相同圓樁直徑D=1.0 m，中心距s=0.8 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.20 m。若只把中心距增加10%至0.88 m，樁徑不變，咬合減為0.12 m，降低40%。這顯示接近幾何閉合條件時，小幅位置變更可消耗很大的餘量。實際還須扣除孔斜、樁徑變異及測量誤差，並用全深相鄰樁位置重建止水路徑；正的名目咬合不是接面水密或結構抗剪已獲證明。~Original teaching example: equal circular piles have D=1.0 m and centre spacing s=0.8 m, giving nominal overlap o=D−s=0.20 m. Increase spacing alone by 10% to 0.88 m while holding diameter fixed: overlap becomes 0.12 m, a 40% reduction. This shows how a small positional change can consume substantial reserve near a geometric closure condition. Actual evaluation must also account for inclination, diameter variation and survey uncertainty and reconstruct the full-depth cutoff using adjacent-pile positions. Positive nominal overlap does not demonstrate either watertight contact or structural shear transfer. Verify the geometric prediction against independent survey and observed hydraulic behaviour.
history: 咬合樁牆以相鄰樁體互相切入形成連續擋土與止水系統，其性能受樁位、垂直度、切削時齡及結構樁剛度共同控制。本課將幾何咬合與材料強度分開驗證，再檢查冠梁傳力、嵌入深度、缺口滲流與長期裂縫，建立全深度的竣工證據。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。~Secant walls use overlapping piles to form a retaining and cutoff system governed by position, verticality, cutting age and structural-pile stiffness. The course verifies geometric overlap separately from material strength, then examines capping-beam transfer, embedment, defect seepage and long-term cracking through full-depth as-built evidence. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
facts: 合成教學假設：假設相同樁徑D=1.0 m、中心距s=0.8 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.20 m~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For equal pile diameter D=1.0 m and spacing s=0.8 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.20 m
合成教學假設：假設先行樁澆置完成t₁=24 h、次樁切入t₂=96 h，相對齡期Δt=t₂−t₁=72 h~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For primary completion t₁=24 h and secondary cutting t₂=96 h on one clock, elapsed age Δt=72 h
合成教學假設：假設完整實心圓截面D=1 m，毛截面I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For a complete solid circular section D=1 m, gross second moment I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴
合成教學假設：假設簡支冠梁跨L=3 m、跨中集中力P=400 kN，Mmax=PL/4=300 kN·m~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For a simply supported cap span L=3 m and central force P=400 kN, Mmax=PL/4=300 kN·m
合成教學假設：假設4項獨立零均值誤差各標準差σ=15 mm，合成σtot=√(4σ²)=30 mm~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For four independent zero-mean errors each with standard deviation σ=15 mm, combined σtot=√(4σ²)=30 mm

合成教學假設：假設每米牆長的反力R=500 kN/m、對開挖底的力臂z=2 m，抗力矩M=Rz=1000 kN·m/m~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For reaction R=500 kN per metre of wall and lever arm z=2 m about excavation level, resisting moment M=Rz=1000 kN·m/m
